description: growthroles tracks every open marketing and growth role across the companies that publish them, rechecked every night so a closed job is removed rather than wasted on you. It adds what no single job board has: employer-stated pay on thousands of roles, salary benchmarks measured across the whole market with sample sizes and dates, and a written read on each role. Ask in plain words, get roles ranked against your own CV, and track what you applied to.

defaultPrompt: Match my resume against open marketing roles and rank the best fits
Find remote growth marketing jobs that list the salary
